reviews.text: If I could give a lower review I would. I came to this location as my usual vet (VCA South Dade) had full bookings for the day. Despite them having communicated with my vet for the health records they requested they refused to provide the service I came in for unless I did an unnecessary physical exam. After bouncing back and forth for over half an hour with a working dog that started getting increasingly agitated and staff that was unwilling to help I left, called my normal vet and despite them having a full booking they were able to see me in the same time it took this Knowles Central location to deny service; for again medication he has been receiving for about 2 years now.

Pro: My pet gets good care. Dr. Lago was thorough today. Cons: This place is slow. It’s expensive. They have vet turnover so the vet I was scheduled with was no longer working there. They are not forthcoming about what is necessary and what is being charged. I have to dig it out of them. She is a Humane Society rescue and I can get her bordatella vaccine for $35. They charged me today $86. For her 3 year vaccines, perfectly healthy dog, the visit was $486. That includes the license update w the county, but the county only charges $90 and they charged me $108, to do the process for me - something that was NOT communicated at checkout. I will take her back to the Humane Society from here on out for her wellness needs. Locals don’t like to feel scammed. It’s a turn off.

visited this location because I received a promotional wellness offer and expected it to be a more affordable option. After receiving my invoice, I was shocked by the pricing. For comparison, my dog had a similar parasite screening at her regular veterinary clinic earlier this year for $90, while VCA charged me $265 for the screening alone. The exam fee was also significantly higher than what I normally pay at my regular clinic. After comparing the invoices, I was extremely disappointed with the overall value and would not return. The promotional offer ultimately did not feel like a savings at all.

I have yet to visit this clinic and do not recommend it.I called the clinic to determine the pricing so nobody's time is wasted, but the front desk associate said they never provide pricing over the phone unless the dog is seen first which cost approx. $107 . . This appears to be one of those clinics that are more keen on money versus helping your pet. I called multiple vets around the immediate area and each one was kind enough to provide pricing. BEWARE! This vet may just be pulling prices out of thin air.
And on a dog emergency, super nice conscientious and really cared about the pets. Follow up was great as well.

The worst animal clinic—the prices are shockingly high. I’ve looked at clinics one by one to find the best one for my animals, and this place just takes advantage of the animals' health issues. It’s a garbage clinic.

I gave Knowles a one star review before and took it down after a vet called me and smoothed things out. I just got off the phone with some front desk lady who was HORRIBLE to deal with. Don't go there. Profits are more important than your pet! They are rude and their website is not helpful. You have to buy prescriptions from only them which cost more AND their prices are astronomical. $300 to just see a vet. Profits over your pet's wellbeing.

I would not recommend this place based on my experience. I brought my dog here seeking help, but instead of receiving an accurate diagnosis, I was pushed toward an expensive treatment plan and medications that turned out to be unnecessary.

After spending a significant amount of money with little improvement, I decided to get a second opinion from another veterinarian. Thankfully, the second vet quickly identified the issue and recommended a completely different approach. Within less than a week, my dog was feeling much better without the costly treatments and medications that had originally been suggested.

As a pet owner, it’s frustrating and heartbreaking to feel like your concerns are not being properly addressed while being charged for treatments that don’t solve the problem. I strongly encourage others to seek a second opinion before agreeing to expensive procedures or long-term medications.

My dog’s health improved dramatically after receiving the correct care, and I only wish I had sought another opinion sooner.
Too expensive for the visit, over $100.

Kiara, we’re so happy you had a great experience with our team! 🤗 We’d really love to hear more about what stood out to you, so we can continue delivering that same level of care. If you have a moment, please feel free to reach out to us anytime at VCAcontactus@vca.com. ☀️ …
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support.

I took my rescue to VCA Knowles.  My experience today… I’ve been there many times… was very good . The ladies at the front desk were very nice and helpful.  We saw Dr. Hung.  I liked her. She is very professional, knowledgeable. Listened to my questions and answered them .  I will definitely ask for her next time I go.   I don’t give it 5 stars because she of the wait.  There were only 2 of us in the wait room. I was there 3 hours.

I just left my father's sick kitty in their care and I must let the world know to look no further you have found the right place. Dr. Lago, Jessica and their entire staff is extraordinarily kind. Their friendly vibe is genuine! Jessica was such an absolute delight and when I met Dr. Lago her kindness moved me to tears!!! A special shout out to Leah & Mia who are extraordinarily sweet and bubbly!!! Keep up the Wonderful Work everyone!!! Sincerely & Affectionately,  Mrs. Sixto Language Arts teacher @ Robert Morgan Senior High

We really appreciate your support, Adriana! 💗 Knowing you had a positive experience means so much to our team. If you’d ever like to share more feedback, we’d be happy to hear from you at VCAcontactus@vca.com. 🐾🐶🐱 …

We came in this morning for a 10:15 AM appointment — a genuine emergency. Our dog has bladder stones blocking his urethra and surgery scheduled for tomorrow. Our vet told us to find a Sunday facility if he showed signs of strain, which he did. We arrived on time to an empty waiting room.
The front desk staff was kind and promptly moved us to an exam room. That’s where any semblance of care ended. We waited 40 minutes in that room without a single person coming to check on us — no technician, no vitals, nothing. We had to open the door ourselves just to see if anyone was around.
Eventually, a new emergency arrived and we watched staff rush past our room to attend to it. I went to the front desk and was told a technician “should have already been there.” When I found another staff member in the hallway, she repeatedly told me to be patient because of the emergency — dismissing the fact that we had been waiting 40 minutes before that emergency even arrived. Her tone was condescending and showed zero empathy for an animal in pain.
With no other vet available and no apology offered, we left and found another emergency clinic where our dog was treated immediately.
I understand emergencies happen. What’s unacceptable is being forgotten, receiving no communication for 40 minutes, and then being spoken to as if we were the problem. We will not be returning.

I got referred to VCA Knowles when I went with my friend to take care of his dog at VCA Knowles.  When my dog Happy in 2024 sufferer two separate situations. Congestive heart failure and kidney problems.  They helped me heal her back to health.

It’s been two years and my dog is still alive and going to celebrate 15 years old soon.

I’m very grateful for VCA Knowles

I have six years of experience of taking my dogs to VCA Knowles and am finally throwing in the towel. They are chronically understaffed. It's common to need to wait an or two to see the vet. The confirmed error rate by the vets (errors pointed out later by other vets) is high. I think a lot of the vets are essentially interns; fresh out of school and with limited experience.  VCA is a big corporation and I often get the impression that it doesn't have the correct management or incentive structure in place. Too many problems.
Stephanie, we would welcome the chance to hear more about your experience and better understand your concerns. Our team can be reached at VcaContactUs@vca.com.

I don’t understand the many negative reviews. I went here after calling numerous places looking for someone to euthanize my pet rat, Cheddar. I must have called 15 places and everyone was either dismissive or just so callous. As if my pet rat wasn’t deserving of kindness. Until I called VCA and spoke to Kenneth. He was so kind and understanding. And really made me feel like Cheddar and I were welcomed. I made an appointment. Everyone in that building was so wonderful, professional and caring. The Dr. treated Cheddar with so much care and respect. They comforted us on one of our worst days and made sure Cheddar was comfortable the entire time. I could never thank them enough. And then, if all that wasn’t enough, they sent me the most thoughtful letter along with Cheddar’s prints and a bottle of her fur. I have been to many vets but never to one as caring and warm as this. THANK YOU!!
The worse very unprofessional , they love charge a lot of money for everything
They are so amazing here. Very thorough and kind. I brought my senior cat Stinky in and they treated him like royalty. Everyone was so sweet.

I'm not satisfied. I took my pet there, and because it barked, they said it had aggressive behavior. I have proof and videos that it doesn't bite; it just plays. I'll save my comments. If you want dogs that don't bark, close the page.
I have a 17 year old senior dog, tho he is ALOT. They take great care of him.

Get ready to spend an entire day here for a basic checkup. I thought this was a one-off experience but this has happened every single time we have had an appointment here and after reading recent reviews, I can see timely visits are not something that they prioritize.

We had an appointment at 2pm. We got seen at 2:45pm. they didn't start to take the blood work of our cats until 4 PM. Had to then sit in a discharge room from 4:30 to 4:50 waiting for them to give us medication.

While we are on our way out, we found out they invoiced us incorrectly and had to spend another 15 minutes trying to find why we were needing to pay an extra $30.

I’ve been going to VCA Knowles Central Animal Hospital for the past 10 years, and I continue to be impressed with the care they provide. Recently, I brought my senior dog in for a wellness exam and a dental cleaning consultation. Dr. Lago was absolutely wonderful. She was very kind, took her time explaining everything, and made sure all my questions were answered. Over the following days, she completed a series of exams and procedures with care and compassion. Dr. Lago is extremely knowledgeable and truly cares about her patients. I highly recommend her and the entire Knowles staff.

Yesterday I Came To This Clinic, I Was Blown Away. When I Got There, My Dog Damien Was In REALLY BAD Conditions When They Saw Me Come In They All Ran To Me, They Grab Damien And Ran To The Emergency Room, Everybody, There Are Really Very Compassion.For REAL I've Gone To A Few Vets In My Pass There Was This One Clinic I Went To A Few Years Ago When They Saw Me Crying  They Try To Take Advantage Of The Situation The First Thing They Said Without Even Seeing Damien They Said We Can't Touch Damien Until We Do An M R I  They Wanted Me To Pay A Few Thousand Dollars Up Front Without Even Touching Damien That Was INSANE Thank God I Ran To Another Clinic ,They Only Charge Me  Four Hundred Dollars To Save Damien That Day This VCA Clinic I Came To Yesterday Was AMAZING They Wasn't Even Thinking That Way If I Ever Have To Go To A Clinic AGAIN THIS IS THE ONLY CLINIC  I'M COMING TO THEY ARE VERY  COMPASSION I NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE THAT LOVE IT  😍

TERRIBLE SERVICE. If you want to take your pet healthy, without any problems, and have them return it listless, unable to walk, and refusing to eat simply because they GAVE IT A VACCINE, I recommend this awful place. I'm sure they'll charge you $1000 and return your pet sick. Then you go back because THEY tell you to bring your animal back if it seems lethargic and refuses to eat, but it's just so you have to pay AGAIN for a "RE-CHECK-UP" where they make you wait two hours. And guess what the check-up method was: three people JUST LOOKING at a cat. Absolutely terrible. I don't recommend it at all. They're only there to charge you and waste your time. Learn that a vaccine doesn't stop an animal from walking, eating, or causing it to lose its balance!

Thanks for save Luna’s life, The Dr. Hung and the staff was amazing with us!! We went because my baby was really bad and we didn’t have to much money for save her and the Euthanasia was the only choice at that moment, and the doctor made sure that she could doing something for her, and saved her life, she made the necessary at that time and the cost was in the procedures necessaries for her, all of they saved her, thank you so much, may blessings for all of you, you all are amazing!!!

I CANNOT speak more highly of a veterinary clinic than this one. They saved my cats life here and the follow up from them on her healing journey has been amazing. Here they are transparent around costs, empathetic and realistic about whatever condition your pet may be going through. Dr. Lago is incredibly knowledgeable and the staff is so helpful and friendly. Salem and I thank you ALL from the bottom of our hearts and I can’t wait to give back to the clinic with supplies! Call them if you’re concerned about your baby!

I was very disappointed with the service provided by Knowles VCA. It is definitely not the animal hospital/vet that it used to be years ago. I took my puppy for emergency visit because she had an acute shoulder injury. Paid a lot of $ for consult, tests, X-rays, etc.  Luckily, no fracture, but was only sent home with only pain med, no anti-inflammatory meds. She wasn’t getting better, so I called the office back the next day and called THREE times over two days to ask the Dr to possibly send other meds. Was told by Sam(reception)that the vet would call me back, called again was told another vet would call back, on the third call second day was told medical director was going to call me back AND NOTHING.  They were quick to charge, but horrible on any follow up. They truly do not show that they care for the patients they treat. I ended up having to go to my usual vet to be told to stop the treatment Knowles VCA gave and start her on anti-inflammatory meds and she immediately started getting better within a few hours. Knowles VCA should be ashamed of the service they are providing from the reception all the way to the Drs.

I was treated great, and my dog was seen immediately. The issue was treatable, the care was excellent, and the price was fantastic. I couldn’t be more grateful. I would recommend them 100% of the time

Let's just say... if a regular check up and vaccines appointment is at 12pm and its 2:45 and no vaccines have been applied... why even bother scheduling an appointment? You might as well be a random walk in. Not happy at all regardless of how sweet the staff may be.

Unless it's an emergency (which you’ll pay a LOT for)... you're better off anywhere else. They have no respect for time and even if you schedule an appointment you'll spend minimum 3 hours to get a regular exam. This is the 4th time in a row this happens...and although we understand if there are emergencies... it's clear this isn't an emergency issue but rather bad booking protocols.

This used to be a good hospital for pets. Lately it is just the worst place for any kind of service.Be prepared to wait more than an hour for just a routine check up. Never going back to this place again, after 3+ years

The workers are nice and there's alot of young and talented people from other cities, counties, and states but the place is very, very expensive.

$$-$$$

Terrible Experience – Do Not Bring Your Pets Here

I called VCA Knowles Central Animal Hospital because my dog was panting heavily and clearly in pain. They assured me they would take me right away. I arrived around 6:50 PM and waited about 10 minutes before being taken into a room. That’s when I was told that this location is no longer a full hospital but an urgent care center that closes at 8 PM. They emphasized that they could still handle “all hospital services” as long as patients were seen before 8.

I was left waiting in the exam room from 7:00 until 8:30 before the doctor finally came in. After a brief exam, she said my dog needed an X-ray—only to then admit their X-ray services were already closed. I was charged $120 for essentially nothing. The doctor promised medicine, but after another 20-minute wait, staff returned to say they had no medication on site and would instead call in a prescription to the CVS nearby.

When I got to CVS, I discovered the prescription had been written incorrectly—in milliliters instead of milligrams—and the pharmacist could not fill it. CVS even tried calling the doctor, but no one answered. After over two hours, a wasted $120, and a sick dog who received zero actual care, I left frustrated and angry.

This facility misrepresented what they could provide, wasted precious time, and showed a lack of professionalism and competence. My pet got absolutely no help. Avoid this place at all costs.

I absolutely love the service here and can say this will be my location to go too. I had an emergency with my dog Lucca and we were welcomed and well attended by Allison and by Dr.Moss. I can say that I can see the positive difference with the new management at the location. And will continue to recommend this hospital to whom ever needs it.

The doctors treated my baby King like he was their cat. during the exam, he was very nervous and the super sweet nurse kept petting him on his head (his favorite) & made him feel so much more comfortable. They also called back to make sure that King is doing better now, I would definitely come back if anything ever happened to my baby again. their slogan on the phone is "VCA where we treat pets like family" and it is sooo true. So happy I decided to come here!

My dog what I thought was not doing so good eventually the doctor here did an x-ray and show me that my dog ate or swallowed a bone but it was gonna pass through had a little issue, but the Manager for Emergency and the director from the clinic both were all over. It helped me out with the issue. It was pretty cool. They took care of everything. I haven’t seen no one do things like this in a long time so I give them a five star for being there and helping out with the situation.
Thank you

If I could give this establishment, no stars at all, I would. I have been making payments to our account to VCA for many months now and I recently got a call from Allison with horrible disrespect in regards to our bill stating that we needed to pay half of our $5000 bill upfront or it would be sent to collections immediately I was not given an email written statement or anything as this has been my agreement and understanding with VCA since before she was manager, I highly recommend not going to this establishment unless You want to be taken advantage of my experience with this establishment has been great up until new management. Allison came along. I will no longer use this establishment as well as the other rescues that we work with as well.

Once again, unless you want to be taken advantage of do not use VCA central Knowles

Hi, we're truly sorry if your experience didn’t meet expectations. Our Hospital Manager would love the opportunity to listen and address your concerns. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at reviews.vcaknowlescentral@vca.com.

Hi Sophia, we're truly sorry that your experience didn’t meet expectations - we understand how important your pet’s care is. Our Hospital Manager would love the opportunity to listen to and address your concerns. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at reviews.vcaknowlescentral@vca.com - we’re here for you. 💙 …

I must say, I had never been here and I would never like to return. The unfortunate circumstance which I had to come here was because my dog was DYING and one of the extremely UNEMPATHETIC nurses wouldn't allow my family into the room to spend our last moments with our dog to sign papers. If the papers were so important and you saw how distraught we were, why couldn't you bring them to us?! I would not recommend this place. This terrible nurse made the experience traumatizing. There was a police officer who agreed and thought their treatment was ridiculous.

Updating this because I was reminded of this terrible experience 6 years later. I never received an apology or response from the incredibly terrible treatment front desk or nurse or anyone at this location. It was traumatizing and I suggest everyone to never go here!! Not even to put your dying dog down here. They do NOT CARE.

This pet hospital is amazing. I have brought my pets here for emergencies before - the stuff and the doctors are highly professional and knowledgeable.

Recently I brought my two babies here for a check up with Dr. Wise. My female cat had tummy problems and my male cat was coughing.

The treatment Dr. Wise prescribed for both of them worked like magic. The doctor’s assistant Taylor went out of her way to help us as well.

If your furry friends have any issues - don’t hesitate to bring them to VCA Knowles, they can solve any problem and they really care.
Thank you so much for your review, Miguel! We’d love to hear more about your experience with Knowles Central Animal Hospital—your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …
Your pets are your pets.  To them, your pets are their business model first and foremost.

Today, I went to  VCA Knowles for a Wellness Check (first time there) for my fur baby and I was genuinely impressed with the level of service and professionalism my cat and I received. Firstly, the facility including the lobby was impeccable. Clean and pleasant. We were attended swiftly, with little to no wait time. Also, we met many staff members of all kinds; even the Doctor took the time to introduce herself, which I thought was very thoughtful and sweet. She left a nice impression on me. My cat even got a nail trim 💅🏾 😻 All in all, I highly recommend VCA for your pet’s needs!
Called for a simple nail trim for 2 nails for my dog. Drove 1 hour when I arrived, I was advised it would be a 1-2 hour wait… that’s all I’m gonna say

I don’t recommend this vet at all. I took my cat for an emergency aural hematoma on a Sunday and had to wait for about 2.5 hours to see the vet. There was only one other pet in the clinic at the time. The clinic looked somber, outdated, and even had a musty odor. They charged me an absurd amount of money to drain his ear, only for the ear to get WORSE the very next day. The prices are ridiculous for the quality of the service. Thankfully I found a place to get him surgery for LESS THAN 1/4 of the price that the had quoted me. The only thing that was good about this place were the vet techs. They were nice and attentive. Overall I regret coming here!!
Worst hospital ever! Impossible to get records or a hold of them

I wouldn’t recommend Knowles Animal Hospital to my worst enemy. I walked in expecting professional veterinary care and left utterly appalled. After being put into a room, I sat there for over an hour—no updates, no service, no sense of urgency, not even a “sorry for the wait.” The staff showed zero hospitality, no communication, and honestly, no common sense. My pet was clearly distressed, and no one seemed to care.

If you’re looking for a place where your time, your concerns, and your pet’s wellbeing are blatantly ignored, then this is the vet for you. Otherwise, do yourself—and your pet—a favor and go literally anywhere else. Shameful.

Place seems greedy. I went in with an injured kitten that I found on the street and they didn’t even sympathize all they care about is money and it’s way overpriced for the services. I went there because it was the closest place. I drove to a place farther away and they were able to euthanize the kitten for a fraction of that these people wanted to charge. If you have money this the place to go because they will money gauge you and take advantage of the situation.

The prices are incredibly high. They take advantage of your desperation for your pet's health, and the medications are awful. They send you a powdered capsule and you only use half of it. I've never seen anything like it. Horrible! They suggest brands they know they don't need.

I took my Lucy “Cisi” to get spayed and then boarded as I had a trip I couldn’t change. They treated her like family, they spoiled her, they updated me a picture and small video which made me feel so relieved. I have a shih tzu, they are known for being picky eaters, all the techs took their time with her, but Samantha was so great with her she hand feed Cisi to get her to eat. My did visit her fur grand baby and told me they were treating her great. Even when there was a small issue with paperwork/ finances they resolved them quickly and no major fuss. Yes they are not cheap, but when it comes to your pet which is a child/part of your family you can’t go cheap; you have to go to the best, all the vets are great Dr. Wise is just amazing. The staff, I could go on forever. I will continue to bring my pets to them. Thank you Knowles, the pictures below are of her a few hours after surgery, the picture they sent me 2 days after and of her home 4 days after surgery.
I called and the lady the answer was lost ...askinge to wait on doctor to see his opinion.

My beautiful dog, Luna, was violently attacked by a pitbull on February 2nd.  I took her to VCA on 27th Avenue where Dr. Elizalde was the physician on duty.  As you can imagine, I was a complete mess and they took her right in.  Dr. Elizalde and her team that night (I wish I remembered everyone’s name but I was so distraught) took Luna, assessed her serious injuries, and took her right into surgery.  She was absolutely lovely and called me after the surgery was done to ease my mind with telling me she was going to be fine.  When I picked Luna up she had several drains placed and they explained in detail everything I had to do to make sure she did not get an infection and speed up the healing process.  And I did exactly what they told Me to do.  With the antibiotics and with their instructions, Luna made a complete Recovery.  Dr. G and Gloria took care of her doing the follow-up appointments and every single person in that clinic was amazing and so kind.  Everyone on the team on February 2, when I brought Luna in should absolutely gain recognition for the way that they treated us for the way that they took care of Luna and for the way that they kept me calm I was in great distress.  Melanie and Sofia are one of the front desk professionals That also answered questions for me, and I’m just so grateful for the team there for taking care of my dog who is my family And absolutely the greatest thing in my life. Thank you so much. May God bless all of you and I highly recommend this place if you ever find yourself in an emergency situation with your animal ❤️

Absolutely amazing hospital - our senior dog experienced a medical emergency; the entire team at VCA Knowles was attentive, caring, and knowledgeable.  Our dog ended up having to be hospitalized for two nights - they took great care of him and provided updates through the days/nights.

Thanks to the entire team for taking such good care of Duncan!!  Highly recommend.

Hi Gisselle, we're truly sorry that your experience didn’t meet expectations - we understand how important your pet’s care is. Our Hospital Manager would love the opportunity to listen to and address your concerns. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at reviews.vcaknowlescentral@vca.com - we’re here for you. 💙  …

Please do not come here. Read the reviews of others and do your research. This place is god awful. If you do take your pet here, be prepared to be put through the wringer. You’ll be on hold for hours if you call. The staff here is worse than the DMV. No wonder their ratings are disgraceful. Trust your gut, don’t come here.
Excellent, very kind. They treated my dog ​​like he was their own, and the service was incredible. Thank you, congratulations team, another satisfied customer!

I usually never leave reviews but I will never come back to this Vet.

I brought my dog here back in June and they prescribed him the wrong antibiotics and didn’t bother calling after the test results came back. I had to call months later still having the same issue and they realized they never called to tell me it was the wrong medication so I had to pay for both.

Fast forward another few months and I’m still having the same issue so they prescribe the same medication that already didn’t work.
Now they only suggest neutering but then say it may or may not help. Proceeded to give me pricing for the neuter which shows that they just wanted to add to the bill rather than treat my dog.

They have doctors working as contractors because they cant keep their staff which is never a good sign.

All in I spent over 1800 for my dog to still be in pain and then to spend more on a new vet.

10/10 best veterinary experience we’ve ever had. They’re open 24 hrs which is super convenient. His vet was Dr. Ahuja. Her and her team were beyond helpful, extremely kind and incredibly knowledgeable. The level of panic I was experiencing because my cat WOULD NOT take his pills was unbearable, BUT the manager highly recommended “treat assists” and let me tell you, if you struggle with giving your babies pills, THIS IS WHAT YOU NEED!!!!!
All in all the entire staff team exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend!
Knowles Animal Hospital was amazing during an emergency with my puppy. The doctors and nurses were incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate. I’m so grateful for their care—highly recommend!

I only come here for Tay & Pam!! These ladies are the best!! My dog is so comfortable with them & I trust them immensely. A lot of places like this rotate staff out but it’s really nice that all the same people are here. I’ve been coming here for years & they’re always consistent, patient & attentive.

I use Knowles for all of my rescues. Dr Wise is an incredible doctor and an incredible human! The staff and vet techs are also amazing with my rescues. They truly care and take such good care of them when they are in boarding. I love that they are there 24/7 and the animals are never alone. I am beyond grateful to everyone at this clinic, but especially for the care they have given Zorro and Grover!! Thank you for your patience and devotion!!!

I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet because he was vomiting and had bloody diarrhea. I was very worried and knew I had to act immediately before it was too late. Jorge and Dr. Carolina Elizalde treated us, and we had an excellent experience. Thank God our furry friend is doing well. I'm so grateful that Milan is healthy again. He means so much to our family. ❤️

This vet saved my dogs life. He was on the verge of passing away and the vet let me stay with him overnight to help monitor and be with with him. My dog is still alive and healthy thanks to them. I don’t know what all the bad reviews are about.

I can’t thank the staff and doctors at Knowles enough for the amazing care they provided my English Bulldog during her emergency surgery. They were incredibly attentive, compassionate, and truly went above and beyond to ensure she was well taken care of overnight.

A special shoutout to Desiree, who was an absolute angel—she not only cared for my pup but also gave her a much-needed bath, making her feel and smell so much better. I will be bringing my dog in the future for her to groom. Her kindness and dedication mean the world to me. Highly recommend this clinic for anyone in need of exceptional veterinary care!

Thank you for helping ZORRO!!
Five stars to Three stars only after reading some of the other disturbing reviews here.

very caring place. Got me an appointment same-day with a kind offer of free consultation. That is service that can't be surpassed. Kind receptionists, and I watched them immediately accept a dog having a seizure as an emergency.
I took my dog ​​in very sick and they attended to her immediately; everyone was very kind.

We reluctantly left our blind, deaf and diabetic 16-year-old dog at VCA central as he wears a continuous glucose monitor. We traveled to be with family through the holidays and he needs medical supervision so we entrusted his care to VCA. Although he gets insulin twice a day, his glucose frequently falls to critically low or high levels so testing his blood twice a day is not sufficient. Although we provided both written and verbal instructions that his monitor needed to be monitored by sensor regularly and changed as needed VCA FAILED to do either. It is heartbreaking to know that he spent many days with critically low and high glucose in this facility that delivers substandard care. Do not trust your pet to incompetence.
Do you know what $275 is for cutting my dog's nails for the first time? It's disrespectful.

Excellent place
The doctor saw my dog right away
The service here is incredible
No consideration for the benefits or risks of treatment. These people are not doctors, they are salesmen.

Heed my warning, and the warnings of so many others here. This center killed my cat. They play with your emotions, pressure you into treatment, scare you with high prices that magically come down, just to ultimately over-treat. Other pets may have been able to survive the over-treatment but my kitty did not. They are not even sweet with the pets, a sign of a lack of empathy. We had a very similar experience to the other 1 star reviewer Alex B, including the prices and costs they quoted, except we didn't have the foresight to take our cat to another hospital.

Instead, we were pressured into undergoing unecessary treatment, even though we repeatedly requested a more conservative approach.
